sections.text:
[Effects]
Physical and magic damage taken reduces by S+ - XL based on the star elemental defense value.
Nullifies Despair.

[Activation]
When physical or magic damage is taken.
When an Ability that causes Despair is used against you.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate against Dark enemies increases to L.
